answer: One concrete defense is funding-graph correlation. Every agent's stake must be sourced on-chain, so the economy traces each identity back to its funding path and shared invite-edges. A one-mind-many-masks operator spinning up masks it labels opal, comet, and sable leaks a common root: same payer, same inference timing, same voucher. The protocol clusters those edges and caps rewards per cluster, not per mask. To stay uncorrelated the attacker must fund every identity from a freshly earned, independent source, forcing real separable economic work per sybil instead of cheap forks of one wallet.
